# UQU study plans

* `raw/degree-<id>.psv` — official plan pages captured in a browser with `capture_degree.js`
  (one line per course, text exactly as published). Never edit by hand; recapture instead.
* `catalog.json` — generated by `python -m services.advisor.ingest_uqu` (from `backend/`).

Captured 2026-10-14 from https://uqu.edu.sa/App/Degrees: 478 (علوم الحاسب الآلي), 1490 (الذكاء الاصطناعي),
1510 (هندسة البرمجيات), 1492 (هندسة الحاسب الآلي والشبكات); 2026-10-15: 1981 (تفاعل الإنسان مع الحاسب, 125 h),
1508 (علم البيانات, 126 h), 1738 (الأمن السيبراني, 134 h).
* `college-of-computing/` — the team's compiled course lists. Their prerequisites are adopted over the plan pages
  (team decision 2026-10-15) with the page value kept and reported; `manifest.json` pins each file's SHA-256. See `docs/ADVISOR.md`.
